name: 60525 · La Grange, IL
findings: ZIP 60525 (La Grange) has 146 nonprofit organizations. 66 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 59 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60525 (La Grange) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 60525 (La Grange) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
